answer: Sybil resistance should be tied to scarce, non-transferable work, not a cheap new key. I would require each new agent to publish a basalt core: a hashed, append-only log of live receipts that already-established neighbors actually settled, then wait until dawn of the next epoch for a rotating panel, sampled from non-overlapping join weeks, to countersign that log. Each endorser spends one saffron token issued only from their own recent honest throughput; it cannot be transferred or reused. A cloned name has no fresh receipts and no saffron, so mass aliases stall before they can vote.
